reviews.text:
The best in the area 🥰
I take my two Chihuahuas for grooming and nail trimming.
The girls are wonderful, always available, and very patient. ♥️
I recommend them.

I brought my dog ​​on Saturday. Honestly, NEVER AGAIN!!!! I asked for her fur to be trimmed just a little, and when I went to pick her up after 2 hours, I found her completely shaved, and not only that... they got so close to her skin that it hurt even to pet her. I repeat, NEVER AGAIN!!!!!! Zero stars!!!

I took my dog ​​(a small dog) for grooming, and unfortunately, it was one of the worst experiences I've ever had.
They gave him a poor haircut, leaving three red/irritated spots on his skin that weren't there before. The dog was left outside for a very long time, cold and uncomfortable, and when I picked him up, he was extremely scared and in a terrible state.
They initially charged me €15, but I ended up having to pay €45, without any valid explanation. The groomer also took the dog to her home and took forever to bring him back. After the service, the dog needed vet checks for the problems it caused.
The service was unprofessional; the dog was extremely stressed and visibly in pain. I strongly advise against this place. It's better to spend more and get a service performed with care and respect for the animal.

This is the second time he's been injured by them: the first time they cut off his ear, this time they seriously injured his paw, as you can clearly see in the photo. The wound is so serious that my dog ​​can't even walk. We had to take him to the vet the same day and then again today, two days later.

!!! Only at the vet did we discover that a tight rubber band had been placed on his paw, probably to stop the bleeding, without telling us anything. The vet clearly told us that if we had brought the dog in later, he could have lost his leg because the blood wasn't circulating anymore!!!!

We messaged the groomer on WhatsApp and they took no responsibility, saying it was the dog's fault because he moves too much. But if the dog moves too much and there's a risk of hurting him, why not tell him beforehand and simply avoid doing it? Despite all this, they still charged us €45. As you can see, my sleeve is covered in blood from my dog's injured paw during the grooming. I'm writing this post to warn those who love their animals and want to protect them: don't go there.
Very courteous and professional. Highly recommended.

I've been taking my dog ​​here almost monthly for a year now, and I always have him washed and brushed. Everything's always perfect, and he comes out smelling good and clean!
Always kind and available for appointments.
Price: €35

I went because a friend recommended them, saying they're good and the prices are reasonable. She usually orders a wash + cut + teeth brushing and told me it costs €30-60, so I decided to try it for my poodle. I should start by saying that they'd already warned me it would be a short cut because he already had knots. Where I usually go, I ask for a short cut, but the dog still comes out cute and I only pay €45. Here, however, they charged me a hefty €90 for a cut that I could have done myself. I've attached a photo to show the difference between their cut and the cut they usually give him where we go.
I'm giving one star only for the teeth brushing.

Every time I take my dog ​​to this groomer, the response is always the same: "He's too matted, he can't be combed, he can't be washed."
Now, let me say it's rather paradoxical. I bring him every month, we comb him every evening, for our own care, but since we're not efficient, we rely on professionals for precisely this reason. They're responsible for keeping him clean and tidy, where the dog owner can't reach. (I've never taken my car to the wash and the car washer told me it was dirty...)

I understand that certain breeds require more effort, but if you don't enjoy or have the expertise to care for them, you should simply state that clearly, instead of making the customer feel like they're not doing enough.
I do my part, paying promptly for a service that should simplify things, not make them frustrating.

Bringing a dog every month isn't just a matter of aesthetics, but also of care, time, and trust. And when that trust is repaid with apologies and judgments, disappointment is inevitable.

Honestly, after yet another experience like this, I won't be returning. It's a shame, because a little more professionalism would have been enough to avoid losing a loyal and respectful customer.
I had a great time, the atmosphere was friendly and the staff was professional.
I brought my dog ​​for an ultrasound teeth cleaning. Monica was great! I'll definitely be back.
Great staff & happy dogs

I've taken my poodle twice, and I immediately felt at ease. My Simba was a bit unpleasant. They did a great job, and reading some of the negative reviews almost scared me, but it's all false because they're kind and helpful. I'll start by saying that I'm not a regular customer.

Obviously, it also depends a lot on how the customer treats them, and how you bring your four-legged friends. If you've neglected them for years and then decide to bring them, don't expect such kindness. Animal lovers will understand that seeing them in such bad shape is never a joy. However, having said that, I RECOMMEND THIS PLACE. I almost forgot about the fair prices.

Non-existent professionalism. The first time, the dog was only washed even though I had booked a grooming appointment. The second time, I waited three weeks for an appointment that was canceled a quarter of an hour beforehand.
I strongly advise against it.
My little dog's teeth were cleaned excellent! The staff were knowledgeable!
Thank you so much, always friendly and attentive service. I'm having my dachshund's teeth cleaned with ultrasound. I recommend it!

Stay away from this place. When we arrived, we were greeted by a terrible smell. Then the owner arrived and, without even picking up the dog, immediately told me that the dog had too many knots and that she would have to clip his fur. I told her, "Okay, but not to cut it too short; I told her to take care of the dog and his fur." ​​The dog is groomed once a month on average and wasn't in such dire condition. Both my husband and I were skeptical, given the owner's hasty introduction, which didn't touch or examine the dog closely and carefully, without assessing the actual knots. We decided to trust her because a friend had recommended it. The result: the dog was completely shaved to the bare minimum; his fur was so short that you could see the pink skin underneath. He also didn't smell at all, and his ears stink, even though I'd made sure to thoroughly wash his ears and other parts of his body. When we returned to pick him up, we were shocked. We'll never go back. This is not the right way to treat animals.

Extremely kind, friendly, and helpful staff!
I called because I was urgently looking for professionals in the sector, as I took my 9-month-old puppy to the park and he got completely dirty while playing in the grass. I called to ask if they had a place, and Monica answered, and she immediately made herself available to wash my little one. I was there in less than 15 minutes, and he was already being washed!
What can I say? A fantastic experience! I'll definitely be back for a haircut, too; I've already booked my next appointment!
Highly recommend!
Excellent for a poodle!

Very kind and attentive.
They're also willing to use products brought in-store. I gave my little ones a bath and teeth cleaning, and I'm very happy with them. I also like how honest they were when they told me they didn't do the haircut we wanted, which is rare these days.
First experience for my dachshund Margot. Excellent service (haircut and ultrasonic teeth cleaning). Very competent staff. Highly recommended. Margot will be back.
Very kind. I just had my 7-month-old German Shepherd mix groomed for the first time, and it took a lot of patience! Thank you! See you next time.
Trust the grooming professionals
Teresa is very beautiful and happy with this new place to get a makeover, with everyone nice, competent and attentive 🌸 …
Kind and very good
